facts.fact: 返程路上 Jules 迟到的戒断发作（needling/hammer-like），怕被 David 看成不可靠的瘾君子而强忍
facts.anchor: Jules’s belated hangover finally arrived. Here was withdrawal, needling and hammer-like, come to collect.

facts.fact: 一周前第一次离家、如今 wrecked；全国都是 Lubbock 的复制（drive-thrus/3D printed/塑料淤青）
facts.anchor: They realized there wasn’t anything special about travel, not really, because everything was just this. A whole country of Lubbocks

facts.fact: Jules 当天杀两人：前台 Rusty（以为他掏枪，实则掏 sucking candies 碟）
facts.anchor: It wasn’t a gun. It was a little dish of sucking candies, each one individually wrapped in little plastic bows.

facts.fact: 第二人=在厨房持 Jules 旧枪欲杀 Bethany 的 tech douche；Jules 先开枪救下 Bethany
facts.anchor: He’d been towering over Bethany Peters holding Jules’s old handgun from the Walmart, just seconds away from ending Bethany’s life.

facts.fact: David 用注射器刺 Bethany 手臂（short out 追踪器）；砸碎她手机
facts.anchor: Then he’s taking a syringe out of his pocket and stabbing it into Bethany’s arm.

facts.fact: 第三个目标 Douglas；David 命令「He's seen our plates」，Jules 被要求灭口
facts.anchor: “He’s seen our plates,” David tells Jules like an order.

facts.fact: Bethany 挡在 Douglas 与枪口之间：「He's an idiot. But he doesn't deserve to die.」
facts.anchor: “Don’t shoot,” Bethany says. She steps into the parking lot and positions herself between Douglas on the ground and the tip of Jules’s handgun.

facts.fact: Jules 枪指 Bethany 头威胁（「记得你偷的枪吗」），被 David 喝止带走；四人上车逃离 Austin
facts.anchor: “I killed two people just now,” Jules brags. “And trust me, I am not afraid to make you the third.”

facts.fact: 结尾独白：Jules 恨 Bethany 但也 sort of in love with her
facts.anchor: Jules hates Bethany Peters, but let’s be real—they’re sort of in love with her, too.
